L0504

Money-like name holds `Float` instead of `Decimal` (D-DECIMAL1)

What

Money-like name holds `Float` instead of `Decimal` (D-DECIMAL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for L0504

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0504: tests/ui_lint/float_money.warn.

Warning [L0504] (float_money): field `price` looks like money but has type `Float`
  --> tests/ui_lint/float_money.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     price: Float
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: floating-point money loses cents on common values like `0.1 + 0.2`
 Fix: use `Decimal` for exact money, or suppress with `#[allow(float_money)]` on the field
